speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development with reference to the Families100 Programme by OCBC, whether the training provided by the Ministry for volunteers from the bank includes identifying and responding to issues relating to mental health, substance misuse, domestic violence and sexual, physical or emotional abuse or neglect.

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development with reference to the Families100 Programme by OCBC (a) how will the programme be evaluated; and (b) if the evaluation is positive, whether the Ministry will consider expanding the programme to include other population groups and other corporate partners.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: Volunteers are introduced to issues and challenges faced by ComLink families.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: We welcome more corporate partners and community groups to volunteer and join us as ComLink befrienders.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, they always go out in pairs, work with these families, talk through their strengths as well as their weaknesses and then, at the end of each session, there will be a debrief and they can look at what are the services, packages, schemes or grants that the families are probably suited and qualify for.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, it is a considered and paired approach that we are taking.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, the befriender is not one who is left to his or her own devices and he is always benefiting from the help of the MSF Family Coach.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I hope that gives some assurance to the Member.

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: I understand that there is no separate evaluation.

speaker: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum Abdul Rahim
text: However, if we are trying to encourage more private sectors to come on board and take up such initiative to help uplift families, would it be better for us to consider evaluating such a programme so that we can showcase the positive outcome so that others can come on board as well?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I think we are aligned in terms of wanting to use some of the outcomes and some of the end goals that we want to reach through ComLink and to showcase to more corporates.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, in many ComLink towns today, we are, in fact, in our infancy.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: But in time to come, we hope to be able to show some of these, not just outcomes, because in terms of outcomes of achieving stability, self-reliance and social mobility, some of these indicators will take some time for us to bear fruit.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, we do want to also look at some of the throughput and output indicators and, eventually, hopefully, have some good outcome indications to show for it.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, we are aligned in the sense that we want to show some of this progress and some of these achievements along the way to more corporates and to more volunteers so that they can all step forward.
